text: Kongu Engineering College (KEC), Perundurai, Erode. An Autonomous Institution affiliated to Anna University. NAAC A++ Accredited. NIRF Ranked in 101-150 band. Offering UG, PG and Doctoral programmes with state-of-the-art infrastructure, modern laboratories, and green campus.

Admissions 2026: UG Programmes in 14 disciplines (AI&DS, CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Mechatronics, Food Tech, Automobile). TNEA Counselling Code 2711. Annual fees range from Rs.75,000 to Rs.1,25,000 approx. Admission Helpline: 04257-226688 / 04257-226600.

Academic Departments: School of Computer Sciences, Electrical Sciences, Mechanical Sciences, Civil and Architecture, Management Studies (MBA) and Computer Applications (MCA). Highly qualified faculty with over 70% Ph.D holders.

Campus Facilities: Maharaja Auditorium (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/BX8SNrCiNfeeATtB8), Central Library (https://maps.app.goo.gl/dBQQvTHvS3SLtKNE6), Convention Centre, Food Courts, RO Water, Modern Gym and 400m Athletic Track.

Placement Records: 90%+ placement percentage. 250+ top companies visiting campus every year. Top recruiters: TCS, Wipro, Zoho, Cognizant, Infosys, Bosch, Hyundai, L&T. Highest salary package: Rs.52 LPA. Average package: Rs.4.5 - 5.5 LPA.
Established in 1984 by The Kongu Vellalar Institute of Technology Trust (KVITT). Autonomous institution offering excellence in technical education, innovation, entrepreneurship and research.
Address: Kongu Engineering College, Perundurai, Erode - 638060, Tamil Nadu, India. Phone: 04257-226600, Fax: 04257-220087, Email: info@kongu.edu, Web: www.kongu.edu
R&D Cell: Approved research centre for Anna University in all engineering disciplines. Sponsored research projects funded by DST, AICTE, CSIR, DRDO and ICMR exceeding Rs. 15 Crores.
Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) curriculum, industry elective courses, foreign language options, honors and minor degree specializations.
COE Office manages end-semester examinations, evaluation, results publication, grade sheets, and degree certificates.
